Forest: Forest shows dark green to nearly black-green vegetation in broad contiguous patches.

Annual Crop Land lacks the repeated dot or grid spacing of tree crowns seen in Permanent Crop Land.
Annual Crop Land typically has low seasonal cover that remains confined within field boundaries instead of merging into continuous natural vegetation.

Herbaceous Vegetation Land shows a fine, fairly uniform grassy texture without the dark coarse canopy pattern of Forest.
Herbaceous Vegetation Land has a brighter, more open surface with limited canopy shadow compared with dense tree cover.

Herbaceous Vegetation Land shows continuous low vegetation with no obvious furrows, harvested rows, or planting structure.
Herbaceous Vegetation Land has mottled grassy tones that are not arranged in organized field bands or strips.

Residential Buildings: Residential Buildings show many small to medium roof footprints clustered closely together rather than a few very large warehouse-like blocks.
